title: Briefing for 2026-11-15
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-15: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds. Wholesale prices rose 0.3% in October, putting annual rate at 6.5%, the highest in nearly four years. UK economy expands 0.7% in third quarter as AI provides 'extra engine of growth'. Analysis: Nvidia’s leadership crisis tests the chipmaker’s role as the ‘central bank of AI’. Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight. China's goods surplus tops $1 trillion for a second year amid calls for Beijing to rebalance trade.
global: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says. Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia. Sotheby's auction of $180m Van Gogh challenged over claims it was 'sold under duress'. Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says. Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever. Beauty advent calendars can cost hundreds - but are they value for money?.
philippines: Philippines, Australia ink updated defense cooperation deal. LIVE UPDATES: 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila. Keeping Ayala in the family: How the Zobels pass the torch. [Tambay] Tiis-ganda muna tayo para sa mga bisita ng ASEAN Summit.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
